name: Regional coal collection feeds four component factories
assumptions: This is a boundary load study, not a recipe-balanced production plan or a measured save.
Fifty-two coal generators collect power for one steel campus and three motor campuses. Water extraction and fuel logistics are outside this boundary.
Each campus has its own ordinary LV wiring after a step-down transformer. This comparison includes only the collection and transmission island.
The same demand is compared on LV and MV. Factory internal losses and transformer conversion losses are excluded.
Transmission spans are straight. The entry node represents the step-up feed into the shared trunk.
